description_en: Writes content in a step-by-step pattern using an outline and summaries
description_zh: 使用大纲+摘编的分步骤的模式进行写作
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi run-step-by-step-writing --workspace-id xxxx --prompt '提示词' --task-id 3f7045e099474ba28ceca1b4eb6d6e21 --session-id 3f7045e099474ba28ceca1b4eb6d6e21 --origin-session-id 3f7045e099474ba28ceca1b4eb6d6e21 --writing-config '{"Keywords":["关键词"],"SummaryReturnType":"Structure","PromptTag":{"NecessaryTips":"必要提示","ReverseWords":"反向词","Position":"立场","Theme":"主题"},"Step":"Writing","UseSearch":true,"Domain":"media","Scene":"新闻写作","Tags":[{"Keyword":"10","Tag":"gcNumberSizeTag"}]}' --reference-data '{"Articles":[{"DocId":"文档-自定义的唯一ID","MediaUrl":"http://www.example.com","Content":"文章内容","Author":"作者","Summary":"文章摘要","Title":"文章标题","Tag":"文章标签","PubTime":"2024-09-10_14:17:54","DocUuid":"8a20e007a6174522af4d6a2657d5526f","Source":"央视网","Url":"https://www.example.com/aaa.docx"}],"MiniDoc":["文章片段"],"Outlines":[{"Articles":[{"Content":"文章内容","Title":"文章标题","Url":"文章链接"}],"Outline":"大纲"}],"Summarization":["摘编结果（模型上下文）"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunStepByStepWriting
